description: Validate a draft sauna project request and identify missing details. This is read-only: it does not store data, send email, select a provider, or share contact details.

brandOrModel.description: Optional sauna brand or model already under consideration.

budget.description: Expected project budget range in US dollars.

city.description: City where the sauna will be installed.

contactName.description: Name of the person requesting the quote.

electricalReadiness.description: Optional description of the electrical power currently available at the site.

email.description: Email address for personal provider-search updates.

heatType.description: Preferred sauna heat type, or hybrid_or_unsure when not decided.

notes.description: Optional project details such as space, access, foundation, or electrical work.

phone.description: US phone number for questions about the project.

postalCode.description: US ZIP code where the sauna will be installed.

projectType.description: Prebuilt, custom indoor, custom outdoor, or not yet decided.

state.description: Two-letter US state code for the project.

name: prepare_sauna_quote_request
title: Prepare a sauna quote request
